note: On 111-acre, spring-fed Long Lake south of Mellen. Lakeside sites 1-5 back onto the lake behind a thin line of trees, with a footpath down to the docks; site 1, a pull-through beside the boat landing, has the most open view. North Loop sites are in the woods a short walk from the lake. Swim beach, boat launch, docks, cabins and glamping. The dump station is kept locked: arrange and pay for it in advance, before 11 am checkout. --Claude
summary: Operator RV-sites page, 2025 map, policies, amenities, Firefly engine, Google 4.7 (249) and imagery read. Base fee 25 -> 34 (the $25-27 sites are 20A tent sites for RVs up to ~20 ft), high $48 confirmed; passes the price gate. Hookups 50A + water confirmed, no sewer; max length 40 -> 42 (Firefly per-site); facilities added. Lakeview kept (sites 1-5 behind a thin tree line by the operator's own words). Weekly/monthly rates posted on most sites and a pipeline-workforce special rate; occupancy check inconclusive (every site unavailable for a June 2027 night, likely not yet loaded; second search hit reCAPTCHA).
flags: Price gate: passes. Cheapest site a 23-ft motorhome fits $34/night (sites 4, 8-10, 21-25; 'Rates start at'), high $48 (site 15). Not checked as a Good Sam Park (no discount needed). Google 4.7 (249 reviews). RV Life 4.5/$$ stored.

LONG-STAY (report only): weekly and monthly rates are posted on most RV sites ($900-1,025/month), and Firefly's special-rate list includes 'Mellon Pipeline Project' (a workforce rate). Nightly rates are posted per site and book online (test 2 passes); no lots sold; the operator leads with nightly resort camping. Occupancy check INCONCLUSIVE: a Firefly search for Tue Jun 15-16 2027 as a 23-ft Class C listed all 20 RV sites UNAVAILABLE (most likely the 2027 season is not loaded yet); a second search for Jul 13-14 2027 returned a reCAPTCHA and was not retried. No evidence read of seasonal holders.

WATERFRONT kept lakeview (no change): the operator says of lakeside sites 2-4 'There is a thin tree line between your trailer and the lake' / 'your trailer will park behind a small tree line', and site 5 'behind a thicker tree line'. Site 1 (about 46.2603,-90.6426, east of the boat landing) is a pull-through with 'a beautiful broadside view to the lake ... just take a few steps down to swimming' - a possible lakefront lead for one site, but it sits beside the boat landing and the available Esri imagery predates the current layout, so open ground to the water could not be confirmed. Default stays at lakeview.

Stored fees.note ('20A back-ins from $25-27, 50/30/20A pull-throughs $42-48') read the 20A tent sites as RV sites: site 6 'can accommodate tents or RV's up to 20 feet', Firefly lists 6 at 18 ft and 7 at 15 ft. Replaced.

Season: no operator page states the camping season (FAQ only says the store was 'CLOSED WINTER SEASON 2022'); stored mid-May - mid-Oct (derived, from earlier note prose) left alone. Snowmobile trail #13 runs from the property and cabins may run in winter.
Website https://www.wildwoodhavenresort.com and phone 715-681-0852 confirmed (Google lists the same).

Pin 46.2611,-90.6427 is Google's point for the resort, at the lake-loop junction north of the docks; the operator map puts the lake, inside and North loops within about 200 m of it (imagery predates the North Loop): OK.
Inclusion evidence describes this campground and is still current.
